name: Awesome Hotel Booking
author: Abdullah Nahian

sections.description:
Awesome Hotel Booking is a minimal and lightweight WordPress plugin for managing hotel rooms and bookings. It allows you to:

  • Add, edit, and manage rooms.
  • Add, edit, and manage bookings.
  • Configure default room settings and booking options.
  • Fully functional admin tabs for Rooms, Bookings, and Settings.
  • Translation ready and WordPress.org standards compliant.

This plugin is ideal for hotels, hostels, guesthouses, or any property management that needs a simple booking system.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the awesome-hotel-booking folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Hotel Booking menu in the WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Start adding rooms and bookings!
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin with any theme?

Yes! It works with any WordPress theme since all functionality is in the admin area.

Can I customize the room types?

Yes, the Rooms Settings tab allows you to configure default room types and occupancy limits.

Is this plugin translation-ready?

Yes! All strings are properly wrapped with translation functions (__() and esc_html__()), and text domain is awesome-hotel-booking.
